Seeking *actual* INSTANT check cashing alternative to Ingo Money
In need of a REAL BONAFIDE *INSTANT* mobile check cashing service that is NOT INGO (nor *POWERED BY* INGO)!!!

Here’s the thing:

I have a $2000 handwritten personal check from a business that was given to me as a distribution payment after a sale of some property owne by the company (an LLC of which I am a member). My bankS (all of them) have stated that it will take seven days for this check to clear with them, regardless of mobile or in person or ATM deposit (except Chime but now it’s he weekend so it wouldn’t be cleared till Monday). 

—The bank it is written on is a regional bank nowhere to be found in Florida (and actually it was just absorbed by another regional bank) so I can’t bring it there. 

—I’m apparently blocked from using Ingo because the first time I used it I was trying to cash a check to myself from another ban account which is I guess a big no-no, as every time I have attempted anything with them since I have received error A103 which I have learned means I’m banned (they are currently re-evaluating my account but I’m not optimistic). 

—AMSCOT has already refused it. Would not tell me why. 

—The Check Cashing Store/Money Mart charges 10 PERCENT which is $200. So, no. And their app is currently undergoing a huge upgrade so it will be down for several days. 

—Walmart doesn’t do handwritten personal checks. Publix does but their cash out limit is $75. Kwik Stop does too but their limit is $500. 

—Check n Go cannot do check cashing in the state of Florida anymore.  No clue why. 

—I have googled the alternatives to Ingo a zillion times today and all the banks/services that are presented as all the apps that do NOT use Ingo, actually, as it turns out, DO use Ingo: Netspend, Green Dot, Ace, Brinks, GO2, MoneyLion, PayPal, Venmo…literally *ALL* of them do. Because INGO is @&$#%ing EVERYWHERE. The ones that don’t (or didn’t) are all defunct (Lodefast, Deposit2Go) or are not instant. 

The one thing I have left to try is some place called “Any Kind Checks Cashed” or something which sounds super janky but whatever.  Also apparently Regions bank will let you do it too if you sign up for their check cashing service with two forms of ID. I figured that out after they closed today however. 

But is there any other option? I really need this money now it’s extremely urgent so waiting isn’t really viable. Any help would be extremely appreciated.
